title: Coordinated milestone map and triage guardrails for API / Console / Runtime release waves
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Purpose: define a lightweight, repeatable milestone map and triage guardrails to coordinate simultaneous releases across the Redwood API, Console, and Runtime teams. The goal is to reduce last-minute scope shocks, align cut windows, and produce a single coordinated release notes cadence for marketing and support.
scope: Define milestone map with owner for each checkpoint (feature freeze, validation window, soft cut, hard cut, release readiness)
Agree cross-team criteria for partial cut vs full rollback
Establish release notes handoff process and single source of truth for end-user changes
Create triage guardrails and escalation matrix for last-mile incidents
Produce a one-page runbook for Program Managers and Engineering leads
acceptance_criteria: Milestone map published and signed off by Eng, Design, Docs, and GTM leads
Cut criteria matrix documented with examples for API/Console/Runtime incompatibilities
Release notes template and submission deadlines established and tested for next wave
Escalation owner list and paging matrix validated in tabletop exercise
Post-release retro cadence and metrics defined (latency regressions, rollout errors, docs gaps)
timeline: 2025-03-03: Draft milestone map shared with cross-functional leads
2025-03-07: Working sync to reconcile incompatible deadlines
2025-03-14: Publish final milestone map and runbook
2025-03-18: Tabletop triage exercise with on-call + PMs
2025-03-21: Cut window for planned release wave 1
decisions: Adopt 72-hour soft cut window where non-blocking UI changes may be deferred to next wave
Runtime breaking changes require a 5 day deprecation notice and a compatibility shim where feasible
Single canonical release notes doc owned by Docs PM; teams submit entries via form with category tags
stakeholders: Engineering: Liam Chen (assignee), Priya Kapoor (runtime lead)
risks: Misaligned cut windows leading to partial feature availability across endpoints
Incomplete release notes causing support churn
Late runtime performance regressions requiring emergency rollback
Overly aggressive scope lock that blocks high-value, low-risk fixes
mitigations: Introduce triage severity buckets and an explicit lightweight approval for high-value fixes inside soft cut
Weekly release notes gating call during the last two weeks of cadence
Pre-release perf sweep for top-10 customer prompts and synthetic smoke tests
Canary rollout policy for console changes with automated health gates
